title: Fix Drug Interaction checker to show fully updated results after manual entry (Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, Food-Food)

requirements.text: Replace the stubbed interaction-check hooks with real client-side React Query queries so that clicking "Check interactions" returns and displays the latest results based on the current manually-entered inputs for: Drug-Drug (multi-drug), Drug-Food, and Food-Food.

quotes: In Drug interaction section when manually putting data and check Drug-Drug, Drug-Food and Food-Food interaction, when click on check interactions must show the fully up-dated results

acceptanceCriteria: Given the Drug Interaction module, when the user enters valid values and clicks "Check interactions" in the Drug-Drug tab, the results list updates to match the current input values (not previous inputs).

Given the Drug Interaction module, when the user enters valid values and clicks "Check interactions" in the Drug-Food tab, the results list updates to match the current input values (not previous inputs).

Given the Drug Interaction module, when the user enters valid values and clicks "Check interactions" in the Food-Food tab, the results list updates to match the current input values (not previous inputs).
The interaction hooks provide working loading and error states (isLoading/isPending/error) so the UI can show a spinner/skeleton and an error message when needed.
The query keys include the normalized input set(s) so re-checking after editing inputs always triggers a fresh computation and re-render.

requirements.text: Implement and enforce input validation for manual interaction checks across Drug-Drug, Drug-Food, and Food-Food before running the check, and display clear English validation messages in the module when validation fails.

quotes: please kindly check and fix it the drug interaction section when manually putting data and check in Drug-Drug, Drug-Food and Food-Food interaction, when click on check interactions must show the fully up dated results and do the validation process
In Drug interaction section when manually putting data and check Drug-Drug, Drug-Food and Food-Food interaction, when click on check interactions must show the fully up-dated results

acceptanceCriteria: Drug-Drug: If fewer than 2 medications are entered, show: "Please enter at least two medications to check interactions." and do not run the check.
Drug-Drug: If duplicate drug names are entered (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive), show: "Please enter different medications. Duplicate drug names detected." and do not run the check.
Drug-Food: If no drug is entered or no food is entered, show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.
Drug-Food: If duplicate drugs or duplicate foods are entered (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive), show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.
Food-Food: If fewer than 2 foods are entered, show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.
Food-Food: If duplicate food names are entered (case/spacing/punctuation-insensitive), show a clear validation message (English) and do not run the check.

requirements.text: Ensure that interaction results shown in the Drug Interaction module are computed from the current local datasets/indexes and are not blocked by backend availability, including: drug-drug lookups via the local drug-drug interaction dataset/index, drug-food lookups via the drug-food dataset/index, and food-food lookups via the food-food dataset/index.

quotes: when click on check interactions must show the fully up-dated results

acceptanceCriteria: Drug-Drug results are produced from the local drug-drug interaction data source and are returned as an array of interaction cards (including "No interaction data found..." cards for missing pairs) that matches the pairings from the entered drugs.
Drug-Food results are produced from the local drug-food interaction dataset/index for each selected drug-food combination, returning a consistent result shape used by the existing UI cards.
Food-Food results are produced from the local food-food interaction dataset/index for each unique food pair entered, returning a consistent result shape used by the existing UI cards.
Performing checks does not require any Motoko/backend changes and works even if the actor is unavailable.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only and must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Adding new external APIs for interaction checking (use existing local datasets/services only).
Changing backend (Motoko) interaction logic or adding new canister methods unless discovered to be strictly necessary to fix stale UI updates.
